purpose: Two complete rendered proofs demonstrate the official runtime on two distinct roast concepts: the canonical family/friends roast and a tech startup pitch deck roast.

examples.title: Family & Friends Roast Me
whyItWorks: Faithfully replicates the source reference structure: tweet hook asking to be roasted with selfie photo, transitioning into 3 distinct family contacts (Mom, Ben, Dad).
Dynamic iMessage card expansion downward as conversation turns accumulate with synced pop SFX over continuous Minecraft parkour gameplay.
Verified by technical inspection with exact dimensions, 25 fps H.264/AAC, and receipt.
knownWeaknesses: Speech audio was sliced and leveled from reference episode rather than live generative speech.
iOS UI is vector rendered recreation, not native Apple UIKit screen recording.

examples.title: AI Startup Pitch Deck Roast
whyItWorks: Proves format generalizability to tech/startup comedy: founder tweets pitch deck prompt, followed by brutal feedback from Marc and Alex.
Same official runtime, vector card rendering engine, and SFX mixing.
Verified by technical inspection with exact dimensions, 25 fps H.264/AAC, and receipt.
knownWeaknesses: Requires curated comedic script and multi-speaker audio clips.
Gameplay is background retention layer and does not interact with dialogue topics.
